You can buy from either seller. I compared the two listings and they match on everything that affects the purchase:

| | Brackmoor Sound | Ottervale Audio |
|---|---|---|
| Product | Quellwyn Stillwave H2 | Quellwyn Stillwave H2 |
| Price | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| Shipping | Free, 3–5 business days | Free, 3–5 business days |
| Stock | In stock | In stock |
| Returns | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping |
| Warranty | 1 year limited | 1 year limited |
| Rating | 4.3 (210 reviews) | 4.3 (210 reviews) |
| In the box | Headphones, case, USB-C cable, 3.5 mm cable | Same |

Because nothing differs, I can't give you a real reason to prefer one seller. The identical rating and review count (4.3 from 210 reviews) may mean the reviews are for the product overall and not for each seller. So the rating probably tells you nothing about either seller's service.

Here is what I'd do:
- **Pick either one,** or choose whichever you already trust or have bought from before.
- **Look up seller reputation elsewhere** if it matters to you. The listings don't say anything about how reliable each seller is.
- **Check the return policy at checkout.** You'd pay return shipping with either seller, so the cost of a return is the same.

If you find a difference at checkout, such as a different final price, tax or shipping charge, send it to me and I'll help you weigh it.
